scope: Read-only implementation/acquisition/rendering audit; no production edits or new attitude diagnostic tool
toolboxPackage: Pinned original fm2m-toolbox-200-edgetx; original bytecode is authority where recovered text is damaged

findings.finding: Both call the same EdgeTX native lcd.drawHudRectangle. No AERODECK Lua-pixel rasterizer is involved. Native work scales with rectangle height; compare matched viewports.
findings.toolboxEvidence: UI-X-original SETTABLE X.HR=lcd.drawHudRectangle; ATT original main/1PC26; AHR original main/1PC224.
findings.primaryEvidence: v2.12.4 radio/src/lua/api_colorlcd.cpp1307–1395; sinf/cosf/tanf and bounded row scanline loop.

findings.finding: Toolbox original TLMUPDS reads current and native min/max for each active registered source, then vFN. CRSF gyro vFN negates pitch-radians and preserves roll; neither side has an attitude smoothing filter. AERO fast path reads current1time peraxis, requires currentness and uses a cached compiled reader. Static call counts do not prove actual updateFPS.

Standalone painted frames force all telemetry acquisition+power/session/input/timer/log derivation with serviceData(true,true), bypassing the200ms/revision cache even though attitude is separately polled eachcallback. Retained mode already stages slower work.
findings.candidate: Use the existing cache-aware serviceData(false,true) contract after confirming actual-app telemetry/setting-reset/current-loss behavior. Keep fast attitude everycallback. This preserves all feature consumers.

findings.finding: Graduated AERO draws11 bankticks with3strokes each(33native linecalls),9 movingpointer strokes,24aircraft halo/foreground strokes and2aircraftrectangles eachframe. Toolbox ATT uses2cold-cached masks+nativeHUD+fixed dottedline; AHR uses1cold aircraft bitmap, nativeHUD/tapes and no custom Lua pitch-caption collision engine.
findings.candidate: Cache exact static bank/aircraft artwork as bounded native mask assets; retain the moving geometry and same pixels. Measure before/after, especially fullapp standalone and widget.
findings.toolboxEvidence: ATT original main/0i loads/masks once; main/1PC51/59mask draws. AHR original init loads DBD_AHL once; main/1PC257 bitmapdraw.

findings.finding: flightValue repeats textWidth for the same text/font in fit tests, fittedText and centering; unit draws requery Ag heights despite vlabel keeping a perfont height cache. Tapes and pitch labels repeat metric calls for unchanged strings.
findings.candidate: Bounded percell last-value metrics and precomputed finite static labels/units. Avoid an unbounded dictionary keyed by arbitrary live values. Keep measured fallback/overflow behavior.

findings.finding: plannedRead validates numeric/type/NaN/infinity and then compiled reader repeats those checks. normalize oracle is not called in the normal compiled-reader fast path; its fallback remains compatibility-only.
findings.candidate: Let the compiled reader own its proven numeric validation while plannedRead retains freshness and source-state reporting. Cover nonnumber/NaN/infinite/currentfalse/zero cases.

findings.finding: cockpit allocates two constant2-element arrays perframe, computes trigonometry for both+roll and−roll, and recomputes zero-horizon origin within caption placement attempts. Pitch label/box tables and bankticks themselves are already preallocated.
findings.candidate: Hoist constant arrays, reuse sameframe sin/cos identities, hoist horizonorigin/slope and cache finite pitchlabel metrics; keep collision geometry and invertedroll coverage.

findings.finding: No continuously growing attitude buffer, warm SD load/conversion, routine explicitGC or unbounded transport queue was found in current warm attitude path. Repeated formatting/measurement/tinytable churn can contribute GC/callback jitter; native budget nearcapacity also leaves less burstmargin. These are risks/opportunities, not proof of a specific long-term slowdown. Toolbox also allocates perdraw closures(AHR3,ATT1); do not claim it is allocation-free.
findings.toolboxEvidence: AHR original main/1PC198/202/203CLOSURE; ATT original main/1PC1CLOSURE.

limits: No FPS equivalence or superiority is established by static op/API counts.
Native comparison must match radio/model/RF/MSP settings, pose sequence, viewport and whole-app execution context.
AHR/ATT component measurements with ordinary ungated state do not prove whole Toolbox application parity; do not bypass licence checks.
Required AERODECK UI/features should remain while removing redundant warm work.
